en.headline: Qatar Airways Cargo opens Hong Kong regional office and signs MOU with Airport Authority
en.dek: Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan said the move reflected confidence in Hong Kong as an international aviation hub and hinted at a forthcoming Central Asia passenger route.
body: Qatar Airways Cargo opened its regional air-cargo office in Hong Kong on Wednesday and signed a memorandum of understanding with the Airport Authority Hong Kong to strengthen cooperation on air connectivity and aviation development.

Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan attended the ceremony and said the establishment of the office reflected the carrier’s confidence in Hong Kong as an international aviation hub. Under the MOU, Qatar Airways Cargo plans to increase flight frequencies and develop new cargo routes through the city, helping Hong Kong International Airport expand connectivity with markets that still have development potential, including destinations in South America.

The carrier currently operates about 56 flights a week between Hong Kong and points on its global network, using both freighter aircraft and belly-hold capacity on passenger flights. Airport Authority chief executive Vivian Cheung said the regional air-cargo market remained highly competitive and welcomed the planned expansion.

Chan also used the occasion to indicate that a local airline would announce the following day details of newly launched flights to Almaty, Kazakhstan, further extending Hong Kong’s passenger network into Central Asia.

zh.headline: 卡塔爾航空貨運設香港區域辦事處 與機管局簽備忘錄
zh.dek: 運輸及物流局局長陳美寶表示此舉反映對香港作為國際航空樞紐的信心，並透露本地航空公司將公布中亞新航線。
body: 卡塔爾航空貨運周三在香港開設航空貨運區域辦事處，並與機場管理局簽署諒解備忘錄，加強航空連繫及航空發展合作。
運輸及物流局局長陳美寶出席開幕儀式，表示區域辦事處的設立充分反映該航空公司對香港作為國際航空樞紐的信心。根據備忘錄，卡塔爾航空貨運計劃增加航班班次及開發經香港的新貨運航線，協助香港國際機場加強與南美洲等仍有發展潛力市場的連繫。
該公司目前每星期營運約56班貨運航班，透過貨機及客機腹艙運力連接香港與其全球網絡。機管局行政總裁張李佳蕙表示，區內航空貨運市場競爭激烈，歡迎其擴大在港業務。
陳美寶同時透露，一間本地航空公司將於翌日公布開辦前往哈薩克斯坦阿拉木圖的航班詳情，進一步拓展香港往中亞的客運網絡。
